Daily vegetation PET (mm) = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ETo x seasonal Kc

Source: R/wbm_kc.R
pet_ref_kc.Rd

The same PET wbm_run() uses with pet_method = "penman_monteith", minus the WBM-specific snow rule, so other models (GR4J, ...) get identical PET.

Usage

pet_ref_kc(daily, static, kc_t_lo = 2, kc_t_hi = 10, kc_window = 15)

Arguments

daily

Daily GridMET forcing (tmin_c, tmax_c, tmean_c, srad_wm2, rhmin_pct, rhmax_pct, wind_ms at 10 m).

static

One-row static table with lat, elev_m, kc_dormant, kc_growing.

kc_t_lo, kc_t_hi, kc_window

Seasonal Kc settings, see kc_seasonal().
